# 仅供测试的夹具，正常玩法 on_actions 或决议不调用。
# 角色作用域为可丢弃的测试皇帝，每例重新建立状态。
tca_test_prepare_judicial_law_realm_effect = {
    save_scope_as = tca_test_law_sovereign
    clear_saved_scope = tca_test_law_circuit
    clear_saved_scope = tca_test_law_other_circuit
    clear_saved_scope = tca_test_law_position
    clear_saved_scope = tca_test_law_commissioner
    clear_saved_scope = tca_test_law_target
    clear_saved_scope = actor
    clear_saved_scope = recipient
    clear_saved_scope = intermediary
    clear_saved_scope = puppet_or_actor
    clear_saved_scope = is_puppet_action
    clear_saved_scope = hook
    if = { limit = { has_realm_law = tca_court_system_song_law } remove_realm_law = tca_court_system_song_law }
    if = { limit = { has_realm_law = tca_court_system_tang_law } remove_realm_law = tca_court_system_tang_law }
    set_variable = { name = tca_court_system_migrated_v2 value = yes }
    remove_variable = tca_court_system_cooldown
    clear_variable_list = tca_test_law_circuits
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_local_names_default_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_local_names_default_law }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_central_names_default_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_central_names_default_law }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_judicial_institutions_enabled_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_judicial_institutions_enabled_law }
    every_vassal_or_below = {
        every_held_title = {
            limit = { tca_is_judicial_circuit_trigger = yes }
            remove_variable = tca_judicial_disabled
        }
    }
    tca_refresh_court_system_realm_effect = yes
    # 任命／头衔回调可能在修复期间改变政治关系。
    # 断言快照在修复后获取，不使用此前输入集合。
    every_vassal_or_below = {
        every_held_title = {
            limit = { tca_is_judicial_circuit_trigger = yes }
            save_scope_as = tca_test_law_collect_circuit
            scope:tca_test_law_sovereign = { add_to_variable_list = { name = tca_test_law_circuits target = scope:tca_test_law_collect_circuit } }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = tca_test_law_circuits
        set_variable = { name = tca_test_law_original_governor value = holder }
        remove_variable = tca_test_law_original_position
        remove_variable = tca_test_law_original_commissioner
        if = {
            limit = { exists = var:song_judicial_title }
            set_variable = { name = tca_test_law_original_position value = var:song_judicial_title }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = var:song_judicial_title.holder }
                set_variable = { name = tca_test_law_original_commissioner value = var:song_judicial_title.holder }
            }
        }
    }
    # 从修复后的当前快照无条件设置两个别名。
    # 不通过检查已清理的继承别名是否存在来选择槽位。
    ordered_in_list = {
        variable = tca_test_law_circuits
        limit = { tca_is_judicial_circuit_trigger = yes }
        order_by = tier
        position = 0
        save_scope_as = tca_test_law_circuit
    }
    ordered_in_list = {
        variable = tca_test_law_circuits
        limit = { tca_is_judicial_circuit_trigger = yes this != scope:tca_test_law_circuit }
        order_by = tier
        position = 0
        save_scope_as = tca_test_law_other_circuit
    }
    scope:tca_test_law_circuit.var:song_judicial_title ?= { save_scope_as = tca_test_law_position }
    scope:tca_test_law_position.holder ?= { save_scope_as = tca_test_law_commissioner }
    # 使囚犯场景与此前登记的可丢弃角色隔离。
    scope:tca_test_law_position ?= { tca_retire_judicial_prisoners_effect = yes }
}

# 在选定发起者宫廷中生成出身低微文官，不继承官职或家族评分。
tca_test_create_judicial_law_target_effect = {
    create_character = {
        age = 30
        gender_female_chance = 0
        dynasty = none
        culture = this.culture
        faith = this.faith
        rite = this.rite
        employer = this
        save_scope_as = tca_test_law_target
    }
}

# 互动夹具：完整儒学教育恰好提供 30 点权限评分。
# 每例断言实际所得评分，不替代正式评分逻辑。
tca_test_prepare_judicial_approval_reply_effect = {
    tca_test_prepare_judicial_law_realm_effect = yes
    scope:tca_test_law_circuit.holder = {
        save_scope_as = actor
        save_scope_as = puppet_or_actor
        tca_test_create_judicial_law_target_effect = yes
        remove_opinion = { target = scope:tca_test_law_commissioner modifier = tca_judicial_arrest_veto_disappointed_opinion }
        add_prestige = 1000
        change_influence = 1000
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_test_reply_prestige value = prestige }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_test_reply_influence value = influence }
        add_character_flag = flag_hostile_actions_disabled_delay
    }
    scope:tca_test_law_target = {
        save_scope_as = recipient
        tca_test_normalize_judicial_score_target_effect = yes
        remove_trait = confucian_education
        add_trait = confucian_education
        add_trait_xp = { trait = confucian_education value = 100 }
    }
    tca_setup_judicial_arrest_roles_effect = yes
    tca_setup_judicial_approval_effect = yes
}

# 仅处理新生成的可丢弃评分目标，不处理真实官员。
# 测试精确边界前，将名望／奉献／功绩输入及原生考试标记清零。
tca_test_normalize_judicial_score_target_effect = {
    add_prestige_experience = -100000
    add_piety_experience = -100000
    change_merit = -100000
    remove_character_flag = passed_child_exam
    remove_character_flag = passed_provincial_exam
    remove_character_flag = passed_metropolitan_exam
    remove_character_flag = passed_palace_exam
}

# 仅供测试的原生替换事务，使用新建专职学者。
# 不借用现任提刑：原生晋升可能使其辞去其他官职。
tca_test_replace_judicial_approver_effect = {
    scope:actor = { save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_requester }
    scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_target }
    scope:intermediary = { save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_old_approver }
    scope:tca_test_law_circuit.holder = {
        create_character = {
            template = tgp_minister_scholar_template
            employer = this
            faith = this.faith
            rite = this.rite
            culture = this.culture
            save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement
        }
    }
    scope:tca_test_replacement = {
        if = { limit = { is_lowborn = yes } create_dynasty = { spread_to_descendants = yes } }
        create_noble_family_effect = { GOVERNMENT_GIVER = scope:tca_test_law_circuit.holder }
        create_title_and_vassal_change = {
            type = appointment
            save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_change
            add_claim_on_loss = no
        }
        scope:tca_test_law_position = {
            change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_test_replacement change = scope:tca_test_replacement_change }
        }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_test_replacement_change
        change_government = celestial_government
    }
    scope:tca_test_law_circuit = { save_scope_as = tca_circuit }
    scope:tca_test_law_position = {
        tca_sync_judicial_holder_liege_effect = yes
        holder ?= { tca_ensure_native_judicial_realm_succession_effect = yes }
        holder ?= { tca_ensure_official_contract_effect = yes }
    }
    # 准备回调期间保留原排队互动参与者。
    scope:tca_test_replacement_requester = { save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = puppet_or_actor }
    scope:tca_test_replacement_target = { save_scope_as = recipient }
    scope:tca_test_replacement_old_approver = { save_scope_as = intermediary }
}

# 仅供司法41/42；在替换前由报告者调用，不改真实原任人物的变量、超时或保护。
# 输入intermediary与tca_test_law_position；输出原任、实际官署/领主与当日剩余任期快照。
# 与下列cleanup成对使用；不得在其它替换用例中隐式调用或覆盖其生命周期。
tca_test_snapshot_replaced_approver_effect = {
    scope:tca_test_law_position = { save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_restore_office }
    scope:intermediary = {
        save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_restore_actor
        liege = { save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_restore_liege }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_test_replacement_restore_timeout value = appointment_timeout_days }
    }
}

# 仅供司法41/42，原六条业务断言后由同一报告者同步调用。
# 输入上面的快照与本例唯一新建tca_test_replacement；无跨日缓存，不取消任何世界计谋。
# 先隔离新人物，再以granted事务精确交还原任（appointment可能按候选缓存另选），
# 后走正式辖属/继承法/契约维护并恢复原剩余任期。原任必须仍存活，不杀原任或其它旧人物。
# 只有官署已实际回到原任，才销毁新人物自己的家门并按既有测试清理恢复保护、结束新人物。
# 若快照或交还失败，保留现场供新增断言失败，不通过销毁真实官署掩盖恢复失败。
tca_test_cleanup_replaced_approver_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_office
            exists = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_actor
            exists = scope:tca_test_replacement
            scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_actor = { is_alive = yes }
            scope:tca_test_replacement = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_actor } }
        }
        scope:tca_test_replacement = { tca_test_cleanup_merit_probe_character_effect = yes }
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_restore_change }
        scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_office = {
            change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_actor change = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_change }
        }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_change
        scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_office = {
            tca_sync_judicial_holder_liege_effect = yes
            holder = { tca_ensure_native_judicial_realm_succession_effect = yes tca_ensure_official_contract_effect = yes }
        }
        scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_actor = {
            clear_appointment_timeout = yes
            if = {
                limit = { scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_timeout > 0 }
                # duration字段按命名script value读取，不能直接传scope:数字。
                # 与既有退休/中央任官夹具相同：临时角色变量→命名数值→恢复后清理。
                set_variable = { name = tca_test_replacement_restore_timeout_days value = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_timeout }
                set_appointment_timeout = { days = tca_test_replacement_restore_timeout_days_value }
                remove_variable = tca_test_replacement_restore_timeout_days
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_office = { holder = scope:tca_test_replacement_restore_actor } }
            scope:tca_test_replacement = {
                # 与司法拘捕夹具相同：只销毁本人物实际持有的新家门，不碰已交回的官署。
                every_held_title = {
                    limit = { is_noble_family_title = yes }
                    save_scope_as = tca_test_replacement_owned_family
                    holder = { destroy_title = scope:tca_test_replacement_owned_family }
                }
                # cleanup已移除本例保护；使用其它测试已验证的原生死因，不留下活的AI方案主体。
                death = { death_reason = death_natural_causes }
            }
        }
    }
}
